title: Discover trending
description: Requires a signed-in Dandanplay account; accounts.login opens user login. Complete Classic ranking with summary dates, ranks, heat/growth metrics. Defaults allHot/week/limit=20/filterAdultContent=true. allHot/allRising use week/month/quarter; newAnimeHot uses currentSeason/previousSeason. forceRefresh bypasses cache; Classic may return stale cache on network failure.
